title.narrative: Support to the decommissioning process of Kosovo A Thermal Power Plant, Re-launch

description.narrative: To prepare the process for dismantling and decommissioning of three non-operable facilities that are placed in the compound of Kosovo A TPP (gasification plant, heating plant and fertiliser production plant), including a detailed study, ESIA report, tender dossier for dismantling and clean-up of the location and all other necessary support needed during the decommissioning process. The preliminary design for the construction of the HWS will be prepared as well.
